responsibility: Validate publication packages and atomically publish both consumer products; also build local packages from DuckDB Gold.

interfaces.input: load.package.load_package(ObjectStore, manifest_key); consumer contract + committed erl_protocol.publication package.
interfaces.output: load.publisher.publish(engine, Package); consumer tables and publication log per consumer contract.

invariants: Validate checksums, gate, product set, types, nullable fields, keys, date and consumer-only ASCII/width before publication.
Serialize publication transactions; identical content skips replacement; any failure preserves the previous valid publication.
external_resources: Consumer SQL Server (SQLite stand-in / PostgreSQL tested separately); ObjectStore; DuckDB only for local package creation.
state_and_effects: Own consumer SQL and rpt/stg tables; creates missing schema, stages/replaces date and writes publication log transactionally.

lifecycle.build: Offline build_artifacts.py --unit apps/publisher; ZIP requires the declared locked external Python environment.
lifecycle.deploy: Local Python application/API; no dedicated cloud deployment. Runner bundles only its declared public_dependencies.
lifecycle.rollback: Rebuild/test selected Git commit with locked dependencies; does not revert data/schema/state.
lifecycle.remove: Update declared callers and local packaging; preserve data, contracts and unrelated executable units.
